name: radiante-ghost-audio-runtime
description: Runtime standalone do Ghost Audio para migracao da extensao Radiante.

scripts.start: node scripts/check-node-version.cjs && node scripts/rebuild-sqlite.cjs --strict && node src/app.js
scripts.dev: node scripts/check-node-version.cjs && node scripts/rebuild-sqlite.cjs --strict && node --watch --watch-path=src --watch-path=.env src/app.js
